title: Chainmail Buff
description: Gives projectile protection to chainmail amour to make it more useful over iron.
body:
## Chainmail Buff
Ever felt chainmail isnt useful? This mod fixes it by giving 25% projectile protection per piece of chainmail - this mod gives chainmail a use condisering it is just rare iron.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
